svg.title: A reference in the language, and in the generated code
svg.desc: Two panels. On the left, what the language says: a single stack box holding 120 with two names above it, altitude_m and alt, joined by a brace, and the notes &alt is &altitude_m and sizeof(alt) is sizeof(int). On the right, what GCC emitted: in a Debug build at -O0 an unnamed greyed-out eight-byte stack slot holds the address 0x7ffd…00c, exactly like an int* const; in a Release build at -O2 there is no slot at all, drawn as an empty dashed box with a cross through it.
